title: Lexy
shortDescription: A fully offline, local-first AI personal assistant — notes, reminders, scheduling, and memory, all running on-device.
problem: Managing reminders, schedules, information retrieval, and repetitive digital tasks manually is inefficient — and most AI assistants require sending data to the cloud.
solution: LexAI Butler ("Lexy") is a lightweight, fully offline personal assistant built in Python. It uses a local LLM (GPT4All running Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct) for conversation, SQLite for long-term structured memory, and JSON-based recall for context — no internet connection or external API required.
currentState: Working CLI assistant with notes, reminders (background-threaded, time-triggered), a schedule manager, and short-term conversation memory (last 50 messages) backed by SQLite. Runs fully offline on Windows with CPU fallback. Voice mode is supported but optional/not always enabled.
whatRyanLearned: Local LLM integration without cloud dependency, structuring persistent memory (SQLite + JSON) so the assistant stays context-aware without hallucinating, and background threading for time-based reminders.
roadmap: Long-term direction is turning Lexy into a more autonomous system capable of writing, editing, testing, committing, and pushing code while operating under controlled approval gates — plus expanding voice control, system automation, smart file search, web APIs, and home automation.
note: Do not claim full autonomy unless the implementation actually supports it. Treat as the flagship/featured project.

title: Ayana Hill
shortDescription: A live e-commerce site for Ayana Hill, a beauty and everyday-essentials shop in Kericho, Kenya.
problem: A local beauty and essentials retailer needed an online presence to showcase products and reach customers beyond foot traffic.
solution: A static marketing + catalog site covering fragrances, hair products, skincare/body care, and sandals, with countrywide delivery messaging and a WhatsApp contact path.
currentState: Deployed with two live surfaces: a main site and a shop-focused view. Real business copy and product categories are live.
